title: Get Involved | Diversity Collective Ventura County

waysToSupport.title: Volunteer Your Talents
waysToSupport.description: DCVC is powered by passionate volunteers who greet center visitors, facilitate youth activities, staff health pavilions, and produce Ventura County Pride.

waysToSupport.title: Financial Contributions & Giving
waysToSupport.description: As a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, individual donations sustain our free rapid HIV/STI testing, computer access lab, and youth mental health sanctuaries.

waysToSupport.title: Corporate & Civic Partnerships
waysToSupport.description: Partner with Ventura County's premier LGBTQ+ organization to sponsor annual gatherings, community wellness initiatives, and cultural education.
